# 4 bedroom terraced house for sale

> This stunning contemporary home has been sympathetically refurbished by the current owners to make the most of this light and airy accommodation which boasts high ceilings and an impressive sense of space. As you enter through the front door you are presented with this well-proportioned entrance hall where rooms lead from and into the impressive open plan accommodation.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 134 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: Abbots Place, Kent
- Cena: £650,000
